contexts.text: The men said to Lot = that the Lord turns to those who are in the good of charity.
Until thy brother [Esau's] wrath goes away = until the state takes a turn.
Lift up thine eyes = advertence from what is his own; as is evident from the signification of lifting up the eyes, which is to think and intend, thus to advert to.
Evil and punishment cohere together there, for as soon as an Infernal Spirit does evil above his wont, punishing Spirits are at hand, and punish him, and this without advertence.
To know what would be done to him (Moses) = advertence.

Stretch out thy hand towards heaven = the advertence and drawing nigh of Heaven. To stretch out the hand = to advert to, for a thing is adverted to and shown by the stretching out of the hand... And since when Heaven is adverted to and shown, one directs the sight and thought thither, it also signifies drawing nigh.
See ye = that they should advert to, and reflect.
